general_feeling_english: I felt like I had become a new person with new glasses, because wherever I went, people would stare at me and ask me questions. The feeling was normal since I knew the relevance of what I was wearing.
challenges_english: On Tuesday, I went to a secondary school where all the students and teachers were staring at me and I was really uncomfortable with it, but I focused on the relevance and went through with confidence. And on Thursday too, I was taking public transport where entering with the light glasses on was difficult, but I managed to enter. And on Saturday, because I had worn them for so long, they were slipping to the edge of my nose, so I needed to push them back most of the time.
act_impact_english: On Thursday, I went to seek a marking opportunity to earn some money, and the officials were not comfortable with me wearing the glasses. It took me a lot of words to make them feel comfortable about it, and though it almost cost me the opportunity, it was finally okay and I got it.
beh_adapt_english: I increased in confidence, because my friends like to tease a lot, and to overcome this, I developed more confidence. On Tuesday, I was around Kejetia market and some boys approached me to ask about the glasses and the other items. They thought it was a camera for spying on them, but I confidently explained to them what it was. It was a serious moment. So my adaptation was to increase my confidence and focus on the aim, because I knew the end was more important than those moments.
social_english: Yes there was. I was in front of a bank on Tuesday, and the security men came to ask about the glasses and I explained to them what I knew about it. On Thursday, at the opportunity I went to seek, there were many people and most of them asked me questions about the glasses. It was funny and interesting to them when they heard about it. They even gave me the nickname 'Digital Digital'.
improvements_english: I would suggest that the light sensor be made smaller and the position should be at the edges if possible, thank you.
